business_model.basis: Stated verbatim in P1 (10-K Item 1) and repeated in P4 (10-Q MD&A).
business_model.claim: DFIN sells three product lines: software solutions (ActiveDisclosure, Arc Suite, Venue), tech-enabled services (document composition, SEC EDGAR filing services, transactional solutions), and print and distribution (conventional and digital printed products and related shipping).
quotes: The Company separately reports its net sales and related cost of sales for its software solutions, tech-enabled services and print and distribution offerings. The Company's software solutions consist of ActiveDisclosure, Arc Suite and Venue. The Company's tech-enabled services offerings consist of document composition, compliance-related SEC EDGAR filing services and transactional solutions. The Company's print and distribution offerings primarily consist of conventional and digital printed products and related shipping.

business_model.basis: Stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, Business section).
business_model.claim: DFIN's customers are public and private companies, mutual funds, alternative investment companies, insurance companies, and third-party fund administrators, primarily in North America, Europe, Asia, and Canada.
quotes: The Company provides regulatory filing and deal solutions via its software, technology-enabled services and print and distribution solutions to public and private companies, mutual funds and other regulated investment firms, to serve its clients' regulatory and compliance needs.
The Company's services and sales teams currently support clients in the United States, Europe and Canada.

business_model.claim: DFIN operates four reportable segments: Capital Markets – Software Solutions (CM-SS), Capital Markets – Compliance and Communications Management (CM-CCM), Investment Companies – Software Solutions (IC-SS), and Investment Companies – Compliance and Communications Management (IC-CCM), plus a non-operating Corporate segment for unallocated SG&A.
quotes: The Company's four operating and reportable segments are: Capital Markets – Software Solutions ("CM-SS"), Capital Markets – Compliance and Communications Management ("CM-CCM"), Investment Companies – Software Solutions ("IC-SS") and Investment Companies – Compliance and Communications Management ("IC-CCM"). Corporate is not an operating segment and consists primarily of unallocated selling, general and administrative ("SG&A") activities and associated expenses.

Future government shutdowns or other factors impacting the attractiveness of U.S. capital markets could result in additional volatility.

risks.basis: Stated in P2 (10-K Risk Factors, Technology Risks section); the dependency is explicitly described.
risks.claim: DFIN's operations depend on third-party hardware, software, cloud services and data storage, and a loss of access or a vendor failure could disrupt service delivery to clients.
quotes: Some of DFIN's systems, operations and infrastructure rely on third parties and utilize hardware purchased or leased or incorporate software licensed from third parties.

Any loss of the right to use any of these systems and services could result in delays in the provisioning of DFIN's services, which could negatively impact the Company's business until alternatives are either developed by the Company or identified, obtained and integrated.
